name: Pitztaler Gletscher
kurzbeschreibung: The Pitztal Glacier, celebrated as the 'Roof of Tirol', is Austria's highest glacier resort, featuring futuristic Café 3.440 and panoramas of the Wildspitze.
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Pitztal Glacier (Pitztaler Gletscher), proudly acclaimed as the 'Roof of Tirol', crowns the valley head of the rugged Pitztal as Austria's highest glaciated mountain destination. Ascending to a breathtaking 3,440 metres on the Hinterer Brunnenkogel, this high-alpine realm is defined by the vast Mittelbergferner icefields and jagged granite horn peaks. An international architectural landmark, the striking Café 3.440 cantilevers boldly over the precipice, treating guests to Austria's highest coffee house and an unbroken 360-degree panorama encompassing over fifty glaciated 3,000-metre peaks—dominated by the colossal north face of the Wildspitze (3,774 m), Tirol's tallest summit. Welcoming elite ski racers every autumn, summer transforms the glacier into an extraordinary high-altitude refuge of pure mountain air.

Route & Anforderungen

The journey into eternal ice begins aboard the underground Pitzexpress funicular, shooting visitors from Mittelberg valley terminal (1,730 m) up to the mountain station at 2,840 metres in just eight minutes. From there, the futuristic Wildspitzbahn gondola glides silently to the 3,440-metre pinnacle. The viewing deck and café are fully accessible without climbing barriers. For mountaineers, the glacier represents the premier launchpad for crossing crevassed snow slopes onto the Wildspitze, which requires crampons, ice axe, harness, and professional alpine guide escort. Standard sightseers must wear sturdy winter-grade hiking boots, windproof thermal clothing, and category 4 sunglasses due to intense glacial glare.

Besuch & Anreise

Travel by car follows motorway A12 (exit Imst/Pitztal) along provincial route L16 through Wenns and St. Leonhard to the road's terminus at Mittelberg. VVT regional public bus lines run regularly from Imst-Pitztal railway station straight to the glacier base terminal. Expansive complimentary parking facilities are situated adjacent to the valley station.

Tipps

Indulge in freshly baked pastries at Café 3.440 while sitting beside the floor-to-ceiling glass panoramic windows gazing straight across at the seracs of the Wildspitze. During summer, visit the nearby educational glacier trail exploring permafrost and alpine climatology.
preis: Cable car ascent charges fares (included free with Pitztal Summer Card)
oeffnungszeiten: Summer/autumn sightseeing July to October; winter glacier skiing October to May
